subject: SEO Update — ARLO — 2026-11-16
html:
Found and fixed a live trust bug bigger than any single page: the homepage's own Google-snippet meta description, its OG/Twitter tags, and a SoftwareApplication JSON-LD description baked into 15 other live page shells were all telling Google and AI crawlers that Meta and/or Shopify are connectable on ARLO today. Per catalog.ts, both are still "coming soon" (Meta: May 2026 ETA, Shopify: April 2026 — both already past due). Rank still flat (30th straight session, 0/22 tracked keywords); backlinks flat 2/1; Domain Trust flat at 6; AI Result Tracker still unconfigured; CI 66/66 green all-time going into this push.

PageWhat ChangedTarget KeywordCheck It
/ (homepage)Fixed the false Meta/Shopify claim in the actual <meta name="description">/OG/Twitter tags (what Google's search snippet and every social preview show), the WebPage and SoftwareApplication JSON-LD descriptions, the visible hero subhead, and an image alt attribute.Literal Google-snippet + GEO/AI-citation accuracy (no single keyword)askarlo.app — view page source, search "Meta"
6 /services/* persona pages, /about, /blog, /contact, /pricing, /compare, /compare/[slug], /destinations, /base-templateRemoved the identical false "...GA4, Search Console, Google Ads, Meta, YouTube, and more" claim from the shared SoftwareApplication JSON-LD description hand-authored into each page's shell.GEO/AI-citation accuracy (no single keyword)View source on any of the above, search application/ld+json
/pricing, /destinations/* (template)Fixed a second overclaim: "One Google OAuth grant links every client's data to ARLO — GA4, Google Ads, Search Console, Meta, Shopify and more" (also factually backwards — Meta/Shopify don't even use Google OAuth).Signup-expectation accuracyaskarlo.app/pricing — "Connect once" section
/compare/supermetrics-vs-arloFixed a comparison-page FAQ answer ("Is ARLO a full Supermetrics replacement?") that implied Meta was already covered by ARLO's live connectors.supermetrics alternative (KD 16)askarlo.app/compare/supermetrics-vs-arlo — FAQ section

Why this and not more FOCUS-cluster content: the connector matrix (5/5) and comparison hub (5/5) are re-confirmed fully built for a 13th straight session. This session closed out the last open item from 11-12's audit (the 4 remaining persona pages — all clean) and then widened the search to the shared Organization/SoftwareApplication boilerplate that 11-12 had explicitly flagged as out-of-scope — which turned out to be the same bug, just with a much bigger blast radius (homepage + 15 page shells vs. one persona page).

Next: left blog-post body copy out of scope (5 posts mention Meta/Shopify in passing — needs a content read, not a mechanical find/replace). Confirmed (again) dead code, not touched: src/lib/schema.ts's unused schema generators, src/components/Hero.tsx, src/content/shared.ts — all zero-importer, flagged repeatedly since 11-09 for a future cleanup pass. Everything else open (GSC sitemap submission, off-page listings, AI Result Tracker LLM engine config, CSP, www redirect, second testimonial, futurlabs.dev backlink, ChatGPT-connector verification) remains a human decision.
